stem: A 6-year-old child has a painless limp, limited hip abduction, thigh wasting and a flattened femoral head on x-ray. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation: Perthes disease typically affects children aged about 4 to 10 years and can present with limp, limited hip movement and femoral head changes. SUFE is more typical in older adolescents.
